round1_dispositions.evidence: Flow is no longer offered where the deployment lacks Flow (plan S3a), and the "API access required" state is removed. Residual dead end: a user in a Flow-enabled deployment without personal access gets the generic error (N1, medium).
No "API access required" message exists; the hotkey pointer was dropped on purpose.

new_findings.description: A user without Wispr API access in a deployment that has Flow configured meets a rejected key with the generic line and no next step. The plan accepts this ("the app cannot know").
new_findings.suggested_fix: Accept, or add one clause to the PR copy review if support questions show up. Not a blocker.
